text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp came to an end once 
again this year. Verxina seemed to have 
built up solid confidence, and—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that moment during the Shuka 
Sho was the peak, but..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My body feels much more fulfilled now... 
It feels like I can grow even more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: A late bloomer...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, then there is nothing 
but hope.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I can become even stronger from here on. 
—Far stronger than even Ms. Gentile!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina radiated a dazzling brilliance. 
Remembering how much she had struggled 
before the Osaka Hai, deep emotion welled 
up—
choice_data_list:
Even though you said you couldn't get any 
stronger...

Even though she said she couldn't get any 
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: P-Please... don't say that.
choice_data_list: Ah, no, I didn't mean to tease you!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like Gentile-san couldn't recover 
in the end.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I heard that too. Apparently their 
record didn't improve much either...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"She's naturally strong, so she's got 
plenty of a cushion, but... ...I wonder if 
even someone like her finds hitting a 
plateau painful."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Once we get back, please let me 
consult you about the menu.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I can do more. I want to... push myself 
even harder!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She will without a doubt return to the 
races even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Every time I grew stronger, you soared 
even higher... And so, you continued to 
reign over my heart.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I'd be in trouble if it 
weren't.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Only by defeating that strong person... my 
absolute ideal, can I truly say I've 
reached the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Alright! Shall we head home—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Verxina-san! You're just in time.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Can you get in touch with Cheval 
Grand-san? It looks like she's still out 
training somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
...Her progress has plateaued a bit. She's 
starting to fall behind the others in her 
generation... and it seems she's getting 
impatient.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think you'll be able to reach 
her. She's almost certainly not looking at 
her phone."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However... I do have an idea of where she 
might go.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Gh... aah...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I knew you'd be here.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...!? B-Big sisters...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I thought if you were too focused to even 
check your phone... you'd surely be 
heading deeper and deeper into somewhere 
deserted.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The bus will be leaving soon. Let's go, 
Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm fine. I'll... go home by myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't go saying you're running 
home... okay? Come on, go with your big 
sis—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I don't care if I have to run! As long 
as... I can be alone...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm sorry...! But... right now, I 
just want to be left alone...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Won't you rely on your big sister a 
little?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Because. I'm sure you wouldn't 
understand, Big Sis..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm fine. They're probably heading 
back to the bus anyway.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She's a good girl. I'm sure she just 
doesn't want to cause any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...When she was little, she used to rely 
on me for everything, though."

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
Um, Big Sis...! Could you take a look at 
my pitching form?

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
I wanna throw swoosh, just like big sis... 
Will you... teach me...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still, right now... it seems she has a 
strong inferiority complex towards me and 
Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've met with Cheval Grand many times 
before, and looking back now, I feel like 
she really did show flashes of that side 
of herself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cheval is such a wonderful girl, too, 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll just brush me off, saying, 
'I'm nothing like big sister.'
choice_data_list:
Then, why not tell them about the 
connection?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Holding a complex about someone means you 
believe they are superior to yourself... 
That you think they are truly wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, if we can show that Cheval 
Grand shares the same blood as Verxina, 
and can shine just as brightly because of 
it—"
choice_data_list:
That might help ease some of your 
impatience.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so, I wonder.
choice_data_list:
If we keep moving forward steadily without 
rushing, someday we'll—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Someday, a path will surely open. Just 
like it did for me... for that girl as 
well..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems what we must do moving 
forward has increased, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
First, I shall display my brilliance at 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. And beyond 
that...
choice_data_list: Let's consult with each other again!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, please do.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what a handful my little sisters 
are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she said that, Verxina's tone and 
expression were filled with profound 
affection—
